Messages.Author: Baaliprimogen
Messages.Body:
Okay. I know there has been some confusion on this subject. Could I get a final ruling on this:
I an action (card or effect) states that you have to burn the edge(or other thing) to make action X. You do only burn the edge if the action is successful, right?
(look at cards like, Hrothulf, Shatter the Gate, Strike with Conviction or even Shattering the Cresendo)

Additional cost is alway paid when action is successful...

Final until someone else asks

> Rulebook wrote:
> If no more attempts are made, then the action is successful, and the cost of the action is paid. If a block attempt is successful, then the blocking minion taps and enters combat with the acting minion.
